{bu}Fixing the pagination bug{/}

The test in `./orders` fails because
{b}`List`{/} computes the offset from a
{i}zero-based{/} page, but pages are
one-based: page 1 skips the first
`size` rows. See {u}the handler{/}
{d}(https://example.com/orders/list.go){/}
or {u}https://example.com/docs{/}.

{b}What changed{/}

{d}• {/}`offset := page * size` became
  `(page - 1) * size`
{d}• {/}a guard for `page < 1`:
  {d}1. {/}return an error
  {d}2. {/}or clamp to 1
{b}[x] {/}test added
{d}[ ] {/}changelog entry

{i}▎ Note: pages stay one-based in the{/}
{i}▎ API. Only the SQL offset changes.{/}

{d}│ {/}{di}go{/}
{d}│ {/}func (s *Store) List(ctx context.C
{d}│ ↳{/}ontext, page, size int) ([]Order,
{d}│ ↳{/} error) {
{d}│ {/}    offset := (page - 1) * size
{d}│ {/}    return s.query(ctx, offset, si
{d}│ ↳{/}ze)
{d}│ {/}}

{b}page{/} {d}│{/} {b}offset{/} {d}│{/} {b}rows{/}
{d}─────┼────────┼─────{/}
1    {d}│{/}      0 {d}│{/}  50
2    {d}│{/}     50 {d}│{/}  50
3    {d}│{/}    100 {d}│{/}  12
